blocks.p: results.json decision index New models: first look Every model setup
results.json has every league result per setup and every risk metric at both margins. The decision index links every scored position, the plays shown, the model choice and GNUbg scoring.
Data files are split per version, league and model, so each loads on a phone. Every number on the site is in one of them. The per-decision browser and its rules texts contain 2,298 files.

blocks.li: Snapshot the league database: python3 tools/site/snapshot.py v3.db STATE (one read transaction; the prompts each model was sent go to STATE/prompts.db; the Nackgammon knockout's matches, from knockout-nack.db next to it, to STATE/knockout.db).
Score every legal play of every decision with GNUbg 1.08 at 2-ply: tools/site/score.sh STATE/snap.db STATE/plays.

Build and check the site: python3 tools/site/build.py --state STATE --out OUT. The build fails, and nothing is deployed, if a number does not trace to a data file, counts do not add up, leagues or versions mix, a published finding no longer holds, or a file contains a private address or credential.

blocks.p: The scripts are in the jevgammon repository under tools/site/; the fixed thresholds are in thresholds.json.
